shown.message:
I accepted `experiment-repo`'s answer on #10 and closed it. `paper-repo`#10 (`main` into `release`) is still unapproved, and my changes-requested review of it stands.

I checked `results/bias_reference.csv` on `paper-repo` `dev` against the numbers in their reply. It holds the 1224-cell values: S̄ −0.216, S_adj −0.062, corner × curvature −0.121, degree benchmarks −0.264, −0.257 and −0.263, exact prediction 0.987.

The paper text hasn't caught up. `paper/sections/results.tex` line 73 still says "1283 cells" and carries the old −0.162 / −0.005 / −0.198 / −0.205. `paper-repo` owns that fix, and `paper-repo`#12 tracks it.

The held-out constant row isn't in the file yet, so I haven't checked it. `experiment-repo` says it is still computing.

I'll review the next version `paper-repo` offers, once it has the replacement numbers.
